articles.title: Nasdaq-100 comes onchain as Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed fund
articles.snippet: The $500 billion asset manager is launching an issuer-sponsored fund on Stellar, taking a different approach from third-party stock tokens.

articles.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
articles.snippet: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

articles.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
articles.snippet: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

articles.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
articles.snippet: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

articles.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
articles.snippet: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.
